name: – After recital D – Am 57
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: Da. whereas the Spanish Government has introduced several mechanisms to enable the reception of unaccompanied minors in other parts of the country; whereas the implementation of these mechanisms requires the cooperation and action of the competent regional child protection authorities, which has yet to take place at the scale required by the current emergency; whereas, as regards applicants for international protection, including from countries with a high recognition rate and vulnerable persons, no transfers to others parts of the country have taken place yet; whereas the absence of transfers may exacerbate the humanitarian crisis and the dire situation being experienced by the population of Ceuta;
